name: Exp_i-KlPrice_Vol_Direct
summary: This EA trades based on direct signals from the i-KlPrice indicator combined with volume confirmation. It enters long when the KlPrice indicator shows bullish trend alignment and volume supports the move, and enters short on bearish alignment with volume. It is a systematic trend-following system without martingale or grid components.
summary_zh: 该EA基于i-KlPrice指标的直接信号并结合成交量确认进行交易。当KlPrice指标显示看涨趋势且成交量支持时做多，看跌趋势且成交量支持时做空。这是一个系统化的趋势跟踪系统，没有马丁格尔或网格组件。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Klimo价格指标(i-KlPrice)的趋势方向判断，结合成交量过滤来确认趋势的有效性。入场条件为：当i-KlPrice指标发出看涨信号且成交量高于阈值时开多单，当指标发出看跌信号且成交量高于阈值时开空单。Direct模式意味着信号不被反转，直接按指标方向交易。出场条件通常依赖反向信号或固定的止损止盈水平，部分版本支持尾随止损。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算方式。资金管理方面，该EA使用固定风险参数，没有马丁格尔加仓机制，但缺少动态仓位调整和最大回撤控制等高级资金管理功能。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Klimo Price indicator (i-KlPrice) for trend direction determination, combined with volume filtering to confirm trend validity. Entry conditions: open long when i-KlPrice generates a bullish signal and volume exceeds a threshold, open short when the indicator generates a bearish signal with volume confirmation. The Direct mode means signals are not reversed — trades follow the indicator direction directly. Exit conditions typically rely on opposing signals or fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, with some versions supporting trailing stops. Position sizing uses fixed lot sizes or percentage-of-equity calculations. Money management employs fixed risk parameters without martingale position scaling, but lacks advanced features like dynamic position adjustment and maximum drawdown controls.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Overall take profit target in points

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于识别订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for trade identification

parameters.name: Timeframe
parameters.description: 指标时间框架，0为当前周期

pros: 结合成交量确认趋势信号，减少虚假突破的风险
Direct模式直接跟随趋势方向交易，逻辑清晰简洁
没有马丁格尔或网格机制，风险相对可控
使用自定义指标i-KlPrice对价格波动进行平滑处理，过滤市场噪音
pros_en: Combines volume confirmation with trend signals, reducing false breakout risk
Direct mode follows trend direction straightforwardly with clear logic
No martingale or grid mechanisms, keeping risk relatively manageable
Uses the custom i-KlPrice indicator to smooth price volatility and filter market noise
cons: 止损默认值可能为0，存在不设止损导致大幅亏损的风险
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
成交量数据在MT5中可能不完整或质量不佳，影响信号可靠性
固定手数模式缺乏根据波动率动态调整仓位的功能
缺少最大回撤控制和每日最大亏损限制等风险保护机制
cons_en: Stop-loss default may be 0, risking significant losses without protective stops
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same bar
Volume data in MT5 may be incomplete or low quality, affecting signal reliability
Fixed lot mode lacks dynamic position sizing based on volatility
Missing risk protection mechanisms like max drawdown control and daily loss limits
improvements: 添加强制止损机制和基于ATR的动态止损止盈计算
增加新K线检查和时间间隔控制，防止重复开仓
实现基于波动率和账户风险百分比的动态仓位管理
improvements_en: Add mandatory stop-loss mechanism and ATR-based dynamic stop-loss/take-profit calculation
Implement new bar check and time interval control to prevent duplicate position opening
Implement dynamic position sizing based on volatility and account risk percentage

risk_points: 止损可能默认为0，在极端行情下可能造成重大亏损
缺少新K线检查可能导致同根K线重复开仓，增加风险敞口
成交量数据质量在不同经纪商之间差异较大，可能产生错误信号
risk_points_en: Stop-loss may default to 0, potentially causing significant losses during extreme market moves
Lack of new bar check may cause duplicate position opening on the same bar, increasing risk exposure
Volume data quality varies significantly between brokers, potentially generating false signals

It enters long when the KlPrice indicator shows bullish trend alignment and volume supports the move, and enters short on bearish alignment with volume. It is a systematic trend-following system without martingale or grid components.
